About

Information about the static CNA blog and the way its content is maintained.

CNA's Blog publishes news, notes, and technical articles about CNA, a C++ reimplementation of the XNA 4.0 API.

How the content is organized

Each article preserves its publication date, author, categories, and tags. Article URLs follow the year/month/day/slug structure so links from the original ClassicPress blog can remain valid.

Articles are maintained as Markdown files and converted into a static website. The publishing pipeline generates the dated archives, category pages, tag pages, RSS feed, and sitemap automatically.
